segments.name: SI Joint segment
products: The Catamaran®™ SI Joint Fusion System
The SImmetry +® SI Joint Fusion System
segments.description: Develops and sells minimally invasive medical device systems for treating patients with sacroiliac joint disorders causing lower back pain.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one business segment: the SI Joint segment.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from selling its SI Joint fusion systems to customers such as hospitals and healthcare providers.
revenueModel.evidence: Accounts receivable are derived from products delivered to customers and are stated at their net realizable value.

changes.text: In 2025, the company acquired substantially all assets of SiVantage, Inc. and SIMPL Medical, LLC, adding the SImmetry + System to its portfolio.
changes.evidence: In August 2025, we acquired substantially all of the assets of SiVantage, Inc. and SIMPL Medical, LLC, including the SImmetry +® SI Joint Fusion System ("The SImmetry + System")
